title: Lantern Night · Part 1
idea: At 2:07 am every light in your town goes out; your neighbors walk smiling toward the forest with lanterns, a dead phone says don't follow them, and a fox with a lantern waits under your window. GO or STAY?
hook: It's 2:07 am, and every light in your town just went out.
caption:
It's 2:07 am. Every light in your town just went out. Every light except theirs. 🏮

YOUR CALL: the fox is waiting under your window.

Comment GO or STAY. Part 2 follows the most-commented choice. 🦊
first_comment: GO or STAY? Part 2 follows the most-commented answer 🦊🏮
